declared.world: createGameWorld production module order, quests on, mobs on, signatures off; players added with addPlayer; ordinary 50 ms step()
declared.clock: performance.now() is a declared deterministic clock; no wall-clock value is captured
declared.clientDoor: QuestDialog is the real imported class; its frame values come from the actual RaidState/RaidPlayerState; the DOM is the declared fake-dom.mts; no browser, renderer, real keyboard or scene is claimed
declared.clientPayload: the scene wiring is re-expressed as (msg) => sendInput(declaredRoom, 'questAccept', msg); sendInput and room.send are the real client function and a declared room recorder
declared.positions: player x/y, status and one forced wall tile are declared and recorded in each case; the handler reads them as the server position
declared.events: all toasts/reveal events are the real SimEvent objects returned by step()
declared.schema: Colyseus Encoder.BUFFER_SIZE is raised to the server's 64 KiB setting before a full encodeAll; the decoded state is the actual decoder's state
